## Summary

- What changed?
- Why is this needed?

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`

## Risk

- [ ] No secrets, private dumps or generated artefacts committed
- [ ] Supabase migrations reviewed when data model changed
- [ ] Known issues documented in `docs/technical/KNOWN_ISSUES.md`
